median-of-two-sorted-arrays.approach: Binary search on partition boundary of the smaller array to partition both arrays into equal halves.

container-with-most-water.approach: Two-pointer greedy contraction moving the pointer with the smaller height inward.

two-sum.approach: Hash map tracking seen values and their complement indices in a single pass.

rotate-image.approach: In-place matrix transpose followed by row reversal.

move-zeroes.approach: Two-pointer write index pushing non-zero elements forward and zero-filling the tail.

lru-cache.approach: Hash map combined with a doubly-linked list for O(1) get and put with LRU eviction.

invert-binary-tree.approach: Recursive depth-first traversal swapping left and right subtrees at each node.

reverse-linked-list.approach: Iterative pointer reversal with prev, curr, and next pointers.

merge-two-sorted-lists.approach: Iterative splice with a dummy head advancing whichever list has the smaller value.

valid-parentheses.approach: Stack matching closing brackets with corresponding opening bracket.

trapping-rain-water.approach: Two-pointer tracking left_max and right_max from opposite boundaries inward.

3sum.approach: Sort array and fix the first element, using two pointers to find remaining pairs.

longest-substring-without-repeating-char.approach: Sliding window with hash map tracking last seen character positions.

coin-change.approach: 1D bottom-up dynamic programming computing minimum coins for each sub-amount.

number-of-islands.approach: Depth-first or breadth-first search grid traversal marking visited land cells.

course-schedule.approach: Kahn's topological sort with in-degree array or cycle detection using DFS 3-color states.

search-in-rotated-sorted-array.approach: Modified binary search determining which half of the array is sorted at each step.

climbing-stairs.approach: Fibonacci progression keeping track of the previous two step counts.

maximum-subarray.approach: Kadane's algorithm tracking current running sum and global maximum.

best-time-to-buy-and-sell-stock.approach: Single-pass tracking running minimum buy price and maximum profit.
